definitions: A single distinct meaningful element of speech or writing, used with others (or sometimes alone) to form a sentence and typically shown with a space on either side when written or printed.
The text or libretto of an opera or other vocal work.
A unit of data, typically 16 or 32 bits long, consisting of a number of bytes and handled as a single entity by the computer's processor.
The second person of the Trinity; Christ.
examples: I looked up the word in the dictionary.
He sent word that he would be late.
Any word on the new project?
Can I have a word with you?
The words to the song were beautiful.
The processor handles data in 32-bit words.
In the beginning was the Word.
They had words over the decision.
